recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is recommended unless a future work group decision changes definition-based Questionnaire precedence behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-17628 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 as a correction to Questionnaire.item.definition after the work group agreed that an earlier application had incorrectly implied ElementDefinition-derived values override corresponding Questionnaire item values.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit b641c08c59f1d31ac03965fb46cad5229b8e9689, which changed the element description from values that SHALL be inferred from the ElementDefinition rather than the Questionnaire instance to values that MAY be derived from the ElementDefinition when the corresponding Questionnaire elements have no value.
additional_context: FHIR-12186 introduced Questionnaire.item.definition with override wording, and FHIR-23128 later removed the obsolete inline mapping list from the element definition and moved detailed guidance into Questionnaire notes. The active Questionnaire resource source now keeps that detailed guidance in source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml, while source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml refers readers to the notes.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current notes state that definition-based attributes can be defined in the ElementDefinition rather than or in addition to the Questionnaire, and that any information provided on the Questionnaire item overrides the information from the definition.

related_jiras.note: Introduced Questionnaire.item.definition and explicitly stated that Questionnaire item values override definition-derived information.
Removed the obsolete inline item.definition list and moved the detailed definition mapping guidance into the Questionnaire notes.
